newsitem.title: USA: Advanced Lighting prices shrs at $24.75.
newsitem.headline: Advanced Lighting prices shrs at $24.75.

text.p: Advanced Lighting Technologies Inc on Tuesday said it priced its offering of 3,000,000 common shares at $24.75 per share to the public.
Of the total offering, 80 percent of the shares were offered in the United States and 20 percent were offered outside the United States, the company said.
Morgan Stanley Dean Witter served as lead manager for the offering with Prudential Securities Inc and Raymond James & Associates serving as co-managers.
Advanced Lighting Technologies Inc designs, makes and markets metal halide lighting products, including materials, system components, systems, and production equipment.
